description.value: Your ability to get from one place to another as rapidly as possible was paramount to your creators. This doesn't just mean you can accelerate to a high speed, but also, you can calculate how to maneuver quickly through different terrains and obstacles without damaging your delicate components or overheating and shutting down. Perhaps you were a delivery drone working in food service, shipping, or medical transports; a messenger robot designed to deliver highly sensitive mail and missives from point to point; a scout tasked with remotely exploring new worlds; or a spy working for the military or engaged in corporate espionage. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
